name: Global Games Show Abu Dhabi
blurb: B2B gaming industry conference and exhibition in Abu Dhabi for executives, investors and publishers, not open to the general public.
notes: Trade-only: the site itself describes it as 'Your Gateway To The World Of B2B Gaming' aimed at senior executives, investors, publishers and decision-makers, with VIP/Business passes from $999 and no general-public fan program (no cosplay/guest-signing content). Marked inactive for this fan-convention tracker rather than tracked as an upcoming edition. Next edition is Jan 27-28, 2027 in Abu Dhabi per the live homepage text (the page's own JSON-LD is stale, still showing a Nov 23-24, 2026 date); exact venue not stated on the site, so not recorded (fixup note's 'Space42 Arena, Nov 10-11' guess does not match the live site and was not used).
